_about: v3: the note says how a line is delivered and guides word choice and register; it never asks for punctuation (the judge penalises any mark the Korean lacks). Wiggle covers eerie voices too; system and template translate terms and romanise only personal names.

types.think_bubble: a thought balloon (a tail of small circles)
types.spiked_bubble: a balloon ringed by thin spikes
types.standalone_text: lettering on the art, without a balloon
types.background_text: text that is part of the scene

guides.speech_bubble: ordinary spoken dialogue. Use idiomatic spoken English at the same politeness or roughness as the Korean.
guides.think_bubble: an unspoken thought, the character talking to themselves. Phrase it as inner voice, not as speech to someone else.
guides.cloud_bubble: light, playful or affectionate speech. Let the wording sound warm and lively.
guides.wiggle_bubble: an unsteady or unnatural voice: shaken by fear, weakness or embarrassment, or eerie and menacing. Choose words that carry that voice.
guides.scream_bubble: the line is shouted. Use short, forceful words; keep the Korean's exclamation marks, and stretch a drawn-out cry or groan as the Korean does (Nooo, Ughhh).
guides.spiked_bubble: a sudden inner reaction (shock, anger, realisation) or a sharp, tense remark. Keep it terse and keep every nuance of the Korean.
guides.hexagon_bubble: a voice through a device, magic or a machine (phone, AI, spell, broadcast). Keep the speaker's own wording; clipped and impersonal only if a machine speaks.
guides.square_bubble: narration or a voice-over. Use clear written English in a consistent tense, without chatty fillers.
guides.system_bubble: a game interface message. Write it as a game notification would read (You have acquired [Title]!), with normal capitals; keep brackets and numbers exactly.
guides.standalone_text: lettering drawn straight onto the art: credits, a notice, an off-panel voice or a short exclamation. Keep it as short as the Korean.
guides.background_text: a sign, screen, label, chat message or book page in the scene. Translate it as that object would read in English, as short as the Korean.
guides.title_panel: a series or chapter title, or a credit. Translate a title's meaning in title case; names stay names, romanised.
guides.sfx_sound: a sound effect or drawn action word. Give one English comics sound or action word (BANG, THUD, GRAB, SHFF) in capitals, about as long as the Korean.
